meta.evidence_status: SIMULATION (synthetic glyph writers and synthetic tremor; not a measurement); plants: pencil model P1 (sim/pencil) and model M1 (sim/pensim), both unmodified
meta.model: pencil_P1: model P1 (sim/pencil, unmodified); revA, pencil_like, pencil_0.3N: model M1 (sim/pensim, unmodified)

configs.revA: Rev A defaults (q_lim 0.55 mm, N0 1.0 N)
configs.pencil_like: pencil-like limits on the Rev A plant (q_lim 0.30 mm, stop 0.40 mm, N0 0.15 N, F_pre 0.05 N)
configs.pencil_0.3N: supplementary: pencil-like limits at N0 0.3 N, where M1 contact is stable (one contact per stroke)
configs.pencil_P1: pencil model P1 (sim/pencil: skid, spring-loaded refill F_c 0.15 N, piezo stage; q_lim 0.30 mm, stop 0.40 mm, user force 1.0 N)

static_ink_offset.M1: formula s0 cos(theta) of the axial slide (guidance.nib_offset)
static_ink_offset.P1: median(ink - housing datum) in contact with the skid on the paper, same writing without tremor, neutral mode

meta.lm: char KN 7-gram + word KN bigram, Tatoeba CC0 (results/ai/text_predictor.json)

setup.calibration_sentence: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog
setup.micrographia: 35 % linear size decrement along the line, no tremor, template at calibration size

breakeven.method: intended letters warped by a smooth random field (first point kept), guided at full authority; writers 0-3, 6 Hz 0.3 mm tremor
